response.sql: WITH race_avg AS (SELECT r.raceId, c.country, AVG(ds.wins) AS w FROM driverStandings ds JOIN races r ON r.raceId = ds.raceId JOIN circuits c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId GROUP BY r.raceId, c.country), country_avg AS (SELECT country, AVG(w) AS avg_wins FROM race_avg GROUP BY country), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_wins) AS a FROM country_avg), above AS (SELECT ca.country, ca.avg_wins FROM country_avg ca, overall o WHERE ca.avg_wins > o.a), grp AS (SELECT AVG(avg_wins) AS g FROM above) SELECT ab.country, ab.avg_wins, ab.avg_wins - o.a AS above_overall_avg, ab.avg_wins - g.g AS above_group_avg FROM above ab, overall o, grp g WHERE ab.avg_wins > g.g ORDER BY ab.avg_wins DESC

assumptions.assumption: Each race's figure is the mean of driverStandings.wins (season-to-date running win count) over all drivers listed in the standings at that race; races without standings rows are excluded.
The 'average across countries' is the unweighted mean of the per-country averages (each country counts once), not a mean over all races.
'Above' means strictly greater than the relevant average.
